notes: Phone notifications for payments: in This Month, tap Get payment reminders and choose before each payment, every Monday, or on the 1st. They arrive at 9 AM your time.
Private by design: our reminder service only gets your due days as numbers and when to send. The notification text is written on your phone, and account names show only if you choose.
On iPhone, notifications work once DebtFree is added to your Home Screen. Calendar reminders still work everywhere.
On iPhone, the bottom tab bar no longer lets the page show through underneath it when Safari's toolbar slides away.
